landing.hero_subtitle: Saba abaganga b'inzobere mu mwanya w'iminota 30, cyangwa wivugane n'umuganga uri ku murongo nonaha. Kuboneka mu gihe nyacyo, imiti ya digitale, no kohereza mu farumasi — byose ku rubuga rumwe

landing.testimonial_1: Navuganye n?umuganga ntavuye mu rugo mbona imiti yanditswe mu minota mike.
landing.testimonial_2: Imiti yangejejweho uwo munsi. Biroroshye cyane!

landing.testimonial_6: Kubona ubuvuzi no kugezwa imiti byari byoroshye kandi bitekanye.
landing.hero_badge: Urubuga rwa mbere rw ubuvuzi bw ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda
